about: The strength-mode rules a built break is checked against. scripts/simulate_strength.py and Tests/movezTests/StrengthRuleChecker.swift each implement every id here and refuse to run when their own list differs, so the script and the Swift cross-check agree on what a violation is. A 'hard' rule is broken whenever a break breaks it. A 'where-possible' rule is broken only when the break breaks it while another move that keeps it, and keeps every other rule the served move keeps, was available for the same slot.

rules.text: A strength break is a warm-up, three working sets and a cool-down.
The sets are the day's two patterns (A: squat/lunge and push, B: hinge and pull); the day's first break is X · Y · Core and every later one X · Y · X.
A later break leads with the pattern that has fewer sets so far today; a tie goes to the one that led less recently.
The pattern done twice uses the same move both times.
No move appears twice in a break other than that repeat.
The warm-up is drawn from the first set's pattern.
The warm-up is bodyweight, not on the floor, difficulty 1 and two-sided.
The warm-up runs 30 s with no rep target.
The cool-down is one END move for 30 s (15 s a side on a per-side move).
The cool-down stretches a region the sets worked.
At most one per-side move among the working moves.
At most one floor move among the working moves.
At most one grip move among the working moves.
Only bodyweight moves or moves listing a piece of equipment the user owns (the kettlebell only where a move lists it).
No Wall-setting move with the wall off.
No move served earlier today in either mode, counting `same` overlaps and their families as one (S8).
No excluded move.
Difficulty at most the cap, and difficulty 3 only in an unlocked pattern (S9).
Each set's dose is the library's dose for its move (S4).
A micro-break draws only from END.
A micro-break never serves a floor move.
No Wall-setting move with the wall off.
A micro-break's two moves differ.
One per-side move for 60 s, or two two-sided moves of 30 s each; a two-sided move runs the minute alone only when no per-side move or partner was available.
The second move keeps the first one's posture, standing or seated.
No region shared with the previous micro-break.
The next full break's regions are avoided.
No move served earlier today in either mode (S8).
No excluded move.
Difficulty at most the cap, and difficulty 3 only when END is unlocked.
A day's strength breaks share one letter: the other one from the last day with a completed strength break, A the first time.
The first N completed full breaks of a day are strength breaks (a skipped one does not count) and every full break after them is an end-range break.
An end-range break is four END moves of 60 s each.
No move appears twice in an end-range break.
No Wall-setting move with the wall off.
No move served earlier today in either mode (S8).
The regions the day's strength breaks worked are avoided.
No excluded move.
Difficulty at most the cap, and difficulty 3 only when END is unlocked.
